topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Oh my gosh, I can hardly sit still thinking about what you and your sister are going through with the house. It’s like, I know how much Nana meant to both of you, and now this place is all you have left, right? It's got to feel like a weight, a sweet, heavy weight. Are you both okay? What are you even thinking? I mean, there’s so much history in those walls, every corner whispers stories. I hope you're talking everything through, really sorting out what feels right. I’m here, you know, if you need to shout or cry or anything. Just hit me up.
